verdict: NO COURT WAS HELD - refutability scored 5/10, explicitly and deliberately below the >=6 auto-escalate line, and the runner routed it to ADJUDICATE. The triage's own recommendation is to convene a court AFTER the ~2026-08-20 print with the decision rule pre-committed, and this adjudication ratifies that. The classification is DAMAGE-ARRIVING and the reasoning is unusually clean because it splits the narrative in two and grades each half separately. The DEMAND leg of the priced narrative - Chinese beauty/DTC consumer weakness destroying the business - is REFUTED: revenue grew +47.5% in Q3'25, +26.7% for FY25 and +22.5% in Q1'26, skincare grew +58.5% and is now 56.2% of revenue, and gross margin is EXPANDING at 80.2%. Fundamentals accelerated through the entire drawdown. The UNIT-ECONOMICS leg is CONFIRMED, and it is confirmed by arithmetic from the company's own Q1 release rather than by forecast: revenue rose RMB187.5M year over year, gross profit rose RMB160.2M, and sales and marketing rose RMB182.9M. The incremental marketing dollar bought RMB160.2M of gross profit for RMB182.9M of spend - RMB22.7M destroyed at the margin, before a yuan of R&D or G&A. Marginal marketing ROI is already below 1.0x. S&M went from 66.5% to 72.2% of revenue, a 570bp step-up, operating loss widened to RMB99.0M from RMB34.1M, and operating cash flow turned negative at -RMB90.0M. Yatsen names the cause itself: increased brand-building investment and higher traffic acquisition costs on Douyin. The second pre-print finding is the guide's shape: the RMB1.20-1.30bn Q2 guide implies +10.3% to +19.5%, down from +22.5% in Q1 and +26.7% for FY25, and Q2 contains 618, the heaviest discount festival of the year, so S&M as a percentage of revenue is structurally unlikely to FALL. Guiding growth down while spending up into the promotional quarter is the wrong pairing. Third, and this is the kind of pre-emption that earns its keep: the Q2 cash line will look great and it will be financing, not operations - cash and restricted cash fell from RMB1.05bn to RMB934.2M in Q1 with operating cash flow at -RMB90.0M, and Q2 will show cash RISING on the roughly $60M first convertible tranche that closed 5/21. Do not read that as a business inflection. The dilution overhang is $120M total at a $4.63 conversion price, converting only after 364 days, which against 1.876bn ordinary shares is roughly 28% dilution or about 31% with warrants. The genuine bull datum is stated fairly rather than dismissed: founder Jinfeng Huang, Trustar and Hillhouse funded at $4.63 with the stock at about $2.39 on the closing date - insiders committing at a large premium to spot - but that is a 2027 strike and the second tranche is still only 'expected later this year'. Why not STRUCTURAL: gross margin is expanding, mix is shifting to higher-quality skincare, Q4'25 printed GAAP net income of RMB3.0M so the model clears at scale, and the Sephora China partnership announced 7/8/26 is explicit channel diversification away from Douyin. This is one print from structural, and the print is the cheap resolver - roughly 0.27x EV/sales on a 27%-growing, 80%-gross-margin business is not obviously correct, which is real dispersion, but a court convened now would conclude at roughly the same time a free, higher-quality resolver lands.

reopen_gates: PRE-COMMITTED DECISION RULE for the ~2026-08-20 print: S&M <=~66% of revenue WITH revenue at the RMB1.30bn top end -> reclassify DAMAGE-ABSENT (the Q1 spend was launch timing) and convene the court. S&M >=70% AND revenue <=RMB1.20bn -> reclassify STRUCTURAL (Douyin rent IS the model) and kill permanently.

CONFIRM THE PRINT DATE: 2026-08-20 is yfinance-derived and UNCONFIRMED. Yatsen's pattern is to issue a 'to announce on X' release 5-7 days ahead (05/19 for 05/26; 02/23 for 03/02) and Q2'25 landed 2025-08-21 - so set a ~08-14 tripwire for the scheduling release, and note the date could seat earlier than assumed.

The one input the print will NOT supply, and which the post-print court needs: peer S&M ratios for Chinese beauty comparables, to establish whether 72.2% is Yatsen-specific or platform-wide Douyin rent. This is the difference between a company problem and a channel problem and it decides the whole case.
Second convertible tranche terms and timing ('expected later this year') - the first $60M tranche closed 5/21 at a $4.63 strike; total $120M implies ~28% dilution, ~31% with warrants.

Sephora China partnership (announced 7/8/26) contribution - the explicit channel-diversification hedge against Douyin CAC. Evidence of real offline/prestige channel revenue would attack the unit-economics leg at its root.
